claims.fact: Rockstar Games After going quite for more than a month after Grand Theft Auto 6 ‘s extended gameplay reveal on Netflix, Cyberleek resurfaced earlier this week with a fresh dump of new footage, including a look at Jason without any clothes on .
claims.quote: Rockstar Games After going quite for more than a month after Grand Theft Auto 6 ‘s extended gameplay reveal on Netflix, Cyberleek resurfaced earlier this week with a fresh dump of new footage, including a look at Jason without any clothes on .

claims.fact: In addition to seemingly using a debug mode to show Jason naked following a day of debate about whether the character would show dong in the upcoming open-world game, Cyberleek also appeared to recreate various snippets of gameplay that mirrored what was shown in the Netflix reveal back in August.
